verse.verse_1: By the heaven and the night-comer
verse.verse_2: And what shall make thee know that which the night-comer is?-
verse.verse_3: It is the star shing brightly.
verse.verse_4: No soul is there but hath over it a watcher.
verse.verse_5: So let man look - from what is he created.
verse.verse_6: He is created from a water drip-ping,
verse.verse_7: That issueth from between the loins and the breast-bones.
verse.verse_8: Verily He is Able to restore him,
verse.verse_9: On a Day whereon secrets shall be out.
verse.verse_10: Then he shall have no power nor any helper.
verse.verse_12: And by the earth which splitteth,
verse.verse_13: Verily, it is a discourse distinguishing.
verse.verse_14: And it is not a frivolity.
verse.verse_15: Verily they are plotting a plot.
verse.verse_16: And I am plotting a plot.
verse.verse_17: So respite thou the infidels - respite them gently,
